heading.title: Of Acceptance and Payment for Honour and Reference in Case of Need

article.title: Drawee in case of need.
article.content:
115Drawee in case of need.

Section 115  ·  Chapter XI  ·  page 24 of the Act
Where a drawee in case of need is named in a bill of exchange, or in any indorsement thereon, the bill is not dishonoured until it has been dishonoured by such drawee.
